+module Auction where
+
+import DA.List (sortBy)
+
+template Auction
+  with
+    security : Text
+    quantity : Int
+    seller : Party
+    start : Time
+    end : Time
+  where
+    signatory seller
+
+    ensure quantity > 0 && start < end
+
+    choice InviteBidder : ContractId Invitation
+      with buyer : Party
+      controller seller
+      do
+        create Invitation with auctionId = self; seller; buyer
+
+    choice CompleteAuction : [ContractId Allocation]
+      with bidIds : [ContractId Bid]
+      controller seller
+      do
+        bids <- mapA fetch bidIds
+        let rankedBids = sortBy (\\left right -> compare right.price left.price) (zip bidIds bids)
+        allocateBids quantity rankedBids
+
+    nonconsuming choice CheckAuction : ()
+      controller seller
+      do
+        now <- getTime
+        assert (start <= now && now <= end)
+
+template Invitation
+  with
+    auctionId : ContractId Auction
+    seller : Party
+    buyer : Party
+  where
+    signatory seller
+    observer buyer
+
+    choice SubmitBid : ContractId Bid
+      with
+        price : Decimal
+        quantity : Int
+      controller buyer
+      do
+        assert (price > 0.0 && quantity > 0)
+        exercise auctionId CheckAuction
+        create Bid with auctionId; seller; buyer; price; quantity
+
+template Bid
+  with
+    auctionId : ContractId Auction
+    seller : Party
+    buyer : Party
+    price : Decimal
+    quantity : Int
+  where
+    signatory buyer
+    observer seller
+
+    choice CloseBid : ()
+      controller seller
+      do pure ()
+
+template Allocation
+  with
+    seller : Party
+    buyer : Party
+    security : Text
+    price : Decimal
+    quantity : Int
+  where
+    signatory seller
+    observer buyer
+
+allocateBids : Int -> [(ContractId Bid, Bid)] -> Update [ContractId Allocation]
+allocateBids remaining bids = case bids of
+  [] -> pure []
+  (bidId, bid) :: rest -> do
+    assert (bid.auctionId == self)
+    assert (bid.seller == seller)
+    exercise bidId CloseBid
+    if remaining <= 0 then
+      allocateBids remaining rest
+    else do
+      let filled = min remaining bid.quantity
+      allocationId <- create Allocation with
+        seller
+        buyer = bid.buyer
+        security
+        price = bid.price
+        quantity = filled
+      others <- allocateBids (remaining - filled) rest
+      pure (allocationId :: others)
*** End Patch
PATCH
